character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every shot: geometric dark-brown bob with blunt bangs, bright hazel eyes, with a stable distinctive face and adult proportions. They are a 1960s mod fashion illustrator who rides her scooter between music clubs. Their signature costume is a tailored cream mini-dress with bold geometric trim, cropped jacket, and knee-high boots. Their defining personal object is a pair of oversized round sunglasses with amber lenses. Keep face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, outfit silhouette, and defining object consistent across every scene.
consistency_rules: Maintain one fixed lead character for the full theme video.
Keep the same face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, age impression, and body proportions.
Preserve the signature outfit design and the same personal item or tool in all scenes.
Do not change the protagonist or add a second lead unless the lyrics explicitly require one.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in checkerboard dance floor, swirling psychedelic wall, retro lounge with round chairs; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with tangerine, hot pink, mod blue, mustard yellow; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by tight symmetrical frame of patterned walls, fast whip-pan across color blocks, top-down spin over a checker floor; clear subject separation and intentional negative space
